summary: Frontend-only regression of EdVNova Pass A design refinement (Header glass, Home sections below hero, WhatsApp button, tokens). Tested at 1920/1440/768/390 with Playwright. Hero is unchanged (git diff confirms; CrystalHero.js untouched; hero-crystal-live canvas shows at >=1024, hero-crystal-static below that). No horizontal overflow on Home at any width. The glass header works (backdrop-filter saturate(1.6) blur(16px), rgba white 0.88) and gets is-scrolled after scrolling. Heights are 61px on mobile and 73px on desktop: 60/72 plus a 1px border-bottom, so the header covers the hero by 1px, which is barely visible. Mega menu and Community dropdown open on hover and with Tab+Enter, and every link navigates. Store/About/Contact/cart/login/get-started links work. Every header item shows a focus ring when tabbed to. Mobile menu, both accordions and all links work and the menu closes after a link is tapped. The WhatsApp button is 46px on mobile and 50px on desktop, has the correct href and aria-label, and does not cover the hero search or CTAs. All homepage section links go where expected. The past-paper picker goes to /past-papers/<qual>/<code> and the collection page renders. The 3 testimonials match the CMS text exactly. Hero search goes to /search?q=. Regression checks passed: /learn/igcse, chemistry workspace with all 5 tabs, store add to cart (badge 1, cart item 1), admin login with Admin Panel in the user menu and 14 admin tabs, new student sees no Admin link and /admin redirects to /dashboard, AI Mentor tab loads for both. The only console errors are the expected 401s on /api/auth/me. One real regression: the GlobalSearch (Ctrl+K) overlay is broken by the new glass header.

ui_bugs.issue: REGRESSION caused by .glass-header backdrop-filter. An element with backdrop-filter becomes the containing block for position:fixed descendants. The GlobalSearch overlay ('fixed inset-0', rendered inside <header>) now measures only 1440x135 px instead of the full viewport. As a result the page below is not dimmed, and clicking outside the modal does NOT close it: the click passes through to the page. In testing it triggered the 'Learn a concept' card and navigated to /learn while the modal stayed open. Esc and the result list still work.

Escape only closes the menu when focus is on the trigger button. After Tab moves focus onto a menu item (e.g. IGCSE), Escape does nothing. The onKeyDown handler is on the button, not on the wrapper div.

ui_bugs.component: Header Learn mega menu & mobile accordions
ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testids on mega-menu links (IGCSE/AS Level/A Level/Courses/Expert Learning/AI Mentor), on the mobile accordion buttons (Learn/Community/More) and on the mobile menu links.

issues: The 'Cambridge' eyebrow (11px, text-slate-400 #94A3B8 on white) and the subject code (text-xs slate-400) are about 2.6:1 contrast, which fails WCAG AA for small text. Use slate-500 or darker.
Mega menu section labels 'ACADEMIC'/'LEARNING' (10px slate-400) also have low contrast.
Rendered header height is 61/73px (60/72 plus a 1px border-bottom) while the Home top padding is 60/72px, so there is a 1px overlap onto the hero. Cosmetic only.

Horizontal overflow: scrollWidth 435 > 390. The [data-testid^=pp-item-] rows (flex with badge + 'View' button) overflow by 45px and the View button is clipped. Also observed: a '..._ms_...' file is labelled 'Question Paper' (data/type mismatch).

Clicking dash-tab-mentor auto-scrolls the window down to the chat input/footer. The cause is messagesEndRef.scrollIntoView in AIMentor.js, which scrolls the whole page. Consider scrolling only the messages container.
The Sonner toast at the top-right overlaps the header cart badge and the Get Started/user menu for a few seconds. Consider position bottom-right or adding a top offset.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the GlobalSearch overlay under the glass header. Render the overlay with ReactDOM.createPortal(..., document.body) in GlobalSearch.js, or move <GlobalSearch/>'s modal outside <header>. Do not remove backdrop-filter. Afterwards, verify the overlay covers 100vw x 100vh and that clicking outside closes it.
Move the Escape handling for LearnMegaMenu/NavDropdown to the wrapper div's onKeyDown (and return focus to the trigger) so Escape also works while focus is inside the menu.
Raise the contrast of small slate-400 text on Home cards (Cambridge eyebrow, subject codes) and of the mega-menu labels to slate-500/600.
Optional: add data-testids to the mega-menu links and mobile accordion triggers; fix the pre-existing /past-papers mobile row overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.js: backdrop-filter on the fixed <header> creates a new containing block. Any future fixed/portal-less overlay rendered inside Header will be clipped the same way, so use portals.
Header.js: the mega menu is opened with onClick={() => setOpen(true)} and never toggles closed on a second click/Enter. That is acceptable, but aria-expanded then stays true until blur/mouse-leave.

Home.js: pp-subject-select <option> elements use the label attribute with no text children, so textContent is empty. It renders fine in browsers, but some assistive tech and test tools read the text. Prefer child text.
Home.js: the hero section is unchanged from the previous commit (verified via git diff HEAD~1) and CrystalHero.js is untouched.

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all requested flows pass; 1 HIGH regression (GlobalSearch overlay) + 1 low a11y Escape issue

rca of the issue: GlobalSearch overlay: CSS spec - an ancestor with a backdrop-filter (or filter/transform) value other than none becomes the containing block for position:fixed descendants. .glass-header (App.css, in an @supports block) adds backdrop-filter to <header class='fixed ...'>. GlobalSearch is rendered inside Header, so its 'fixed inset-0' overlay is sized relative to the header box (measured 1440x135) and not the viewport. Repro: at 1440 wide, click global-search-trigger, then click at (300,800): the page navigates to /learn and the modal stays open. Fix: render the overlay with createPortal into document.body.
